desc: wasm-opt (binaryen): optimizes a WebAssembly binary for size and speed (-Os style passes).
usage: POST /v1/svc/cx-wasm-opt with the module bytes as the input blob ({"in":"<blob hash>"}); the output blob is the optimized module (binaryen default passes, optimizeLevel 2, shrinkLevel 1, debug info dropped, default features). Malformed input: "err ..." on stdout, exit 1. Large module: pinned, so donors with PIN_MAX_MB serve it; expect several seconds.
